title: Flyto2 Core arbitrary file write via image.download output_dir bypass (CVE-2026-67429)
summary: flyto-core (a PyPI MCP-native AI agent execution engine) versions before 2.26.7 let callers of the image.download module set both output_path and the output_dir base it is validated against, so the path-confinement check is meaningless: attacker-controlled HTTP response bytes can be written to any absolute path the process can write. Rated CVSS 10.0 (scope-changed integrity/availability impact). Fixed in 2.26.7.
